subject: agent
title: Task agent for fixed-step extraction
body: Use a task agent with a strict output schema for document extraction whose steps are fixed and whose inputs are standard forms.

subject: agent
title: Conversational agent for dialogue
body: When the user works through dialogue, build a conversational agent that clarifies ambiguous requests before drafting anything.

subject: agent
title: Self-check anything with financial impact
body: Any agent that writes to the ERP or whose mistakes have financial impact must check its own output: totals reconcile and every amount is traceable to the source document.

subject: workflow
title: No payments without human review
body: Never let an agent post a payment or change vendor bank details without a human review step (segregation of duties, SOX).

subject: workflow
title: Planner–executor for mixed-format comparisons
body: When documents arrive in mixed formats and the comparison takes many steps, plan first and execute second so the plan can be reviewed.

subject: workflow
title: No agents for rules or analytics
body: Budget checks, threshold checks and process-mining queries are deterministic: build them as activities, not agents.

subject: agent
title: Name agents by business domain
body: Agent names reflect the business domain, not the product or vendor: 'Invoice Extraction Agent', not 'SAP Invoice Bot'.

subject: both
title: Redact bank and tax identifiers
body: Bank account numbers and tax IDs are redacted from logs and never sent to third-party services without a data processing agreement.

subject: agent
title: State the input contract
body: Instructions state the input contract, the output schema and what to do outside the contract: return a structured error rather than guess.
